chunks: Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad ibn ʿĪsā, from Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad ibn Abī Naṣr, from al-Ḍaḥḥāk ibn Yazīd, from ʿUbayd ibn Zurārah, from Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, concerning:
His, Exalted is He, saying: “Establish the salat (prayer) at the decline of the sun until the darkness of the night.”

He said: Allah, Exalted is He, has made four salats obligatory, the beginning of whose time is from the decline of the sun until midnight. Among them are two salats whose initial time is from the time of the sun’s decline until sunset, except that this one is before that one.

So the proper way to reconcile these reports is that we interpret them as referring to one who has excuses and ailments with which he is unable to perform the salat at the beginning of the time. Abū al-Ḥasan عليه السلام clarified that in the narration of Ibrāhīm al-Karkhī from him when he said: “That is due to an excuse, and it is neglect.” We have also previously stated that it is not permissible to treat the end of the two times as a time except due to an excuse, and that further clarifies it.

key_terms.الْأَعْذَارِ: valid excuses that justify delaying salat (prayer) from its preferred beginning time
key_terms.الْأَعْلَالِ: ailments or impediments that prevent timely performance of salat (prayer)
key_terms.انْتِصَافِ اللَّيْلِ: midnight, the endpoint of the broader time range mentioned for the four prayers
key_terms.تَضْيِيعٌ: neglect, indicating blameworthiness in delaying without a valid excuse
key_terms.دُلُوكِ الشَّمْسِ: the decline of the sun, marking the beginning of the prayer time window discussed here
key_terms.زَوَالُ الشَّمْسِ: solar noon or the sun’s passing the meridian, the beginning of the relevant prayer time
key_terms.غَسَقِ اللَّيْلِ: the darkening of the night, indicating the later limit of the time span mentioned in the verse

ai.seo_question: How does this narration explain the prayer times in the verse “Establish the salat at the decline of the sun until the darkness of the night”?
ai.summary: This passage explains the verse about establishing salat (prayer) from the decline of the sun until the darkness of night as referring to the span of time covering four obligatory prayers. It also clarifies that reports allowing delay are to be understood as applying to people with valid excuses, while performing salat at the beginning of its time remains the norm.
